cards.name: Hiro's Shadow Scout
cards.officialText: FLIP: Your opponent draws 3 cards. Both players look at the cards. If there are any Spell Cards among them, discard all those Spell Card(s) to the Graveyard.

design.trigger: Any actual flip face-up event: Flip Summon, battle, or card effect. Snapshot controller and physical UID; source may already be in GY when the trigger is queued.
design.draw: Draw from only the active opposing physical seat's private Deck, top-first, using existing classic drawCards semantics. Inactive partner's private Deck is untouched.
design.reveal: All three drawn identities are returned in a public reveal list/log for both teams.
design.discard: Only Spell Cards among the three move to the opponent team's shared GY; Trap and Monster cards remain in the active opponent's private hand.
design.deckOut: If the active opposing Deck has fewer than three, mirror handFlow.drawCards classic behavior: no partial draw, immediate finish for the opponent with reason 'não conseguiu comprar 3 cartas'.
design.ownership: Preserve each UID m0–m3. Physical owner is not rewritten; shared GY is the team's zone.
